data.one_liner: A tiny, secure, URL-friendly, unique string ID generator with a pure Dart API.
data.what_it_does: Generates unique string IDs using a customizable length and alphabet. Supports secure random generation out of the box and various predefined alphabets like URL-safe, lowercase, uppercase, numbers, and base58.
use_when: You need to generate unique identifiers or IDs for database records.
You need URL-friendly or custom-alphabet string IDs with a specific collision resistance.
avoid_when: You specifically require sequential integer IDs (e.g., auto-incrementing database keys).
strengths: Pure Dart API with zero dependencies.
Highly configurable length and numerous built-in alphabets (base58, crockfordBase32, cookieSafe, etc.).
Uses cryptographically secure random number generators by default.
weaknesses: Lacks an asynchronous API out of the box (though it can be wrapped in a Future if needed).

alternatives.name: uuid
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you strictly need standard UUIDs (v1, v4, v5) instead of customizable compact string IDs.
